auth.label: API Key
auth.description: DumplingAI API key sent as a Bearer token. Create or copy a key at https://app.dumplingai.com/settings/api-keys.

actions.name: get_balance
actions.description: Get balance and budget information for the connected DumplingAI API key.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to get the DumplingAI balance.

outputSchema.description: The JSON response returned by the DumplingAI API.

actions.name: get_catalog_details
actions.description: Get the current contract and metadata for a DumplingAI catalog item.

id.description: The capability, provider, or endpoint ID to inspect.

type.description: The catalog object type to search or inspect.

includeRelated.description: Whether to include related capabilities, providers, and endpoints.

outputSchema.description: The JSON response returned by the DumplingAI API.

actions.name: list_transactions
actions.description: List credit transactions for the connected DumplingAI API key.

limit.description: The maximum number of transactions to return.

outputSchema.description: The JSON response returned by the DumplingAI API.

actions.name: list_usage
actions.description: List usage and request logs for the connected DumplingAI API key.

objectType.description: The catalog object type to search or inspect.

status.description: The request status to filter by.

provider.description: The managed provider ID to filter by.

objectId.description: The capability or endpoint ID to filter by.

limit.description: The maximum number of usage records to return.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for DumplingAI usage records.

outputSchema.description: The JSON response returned by the DumplingAI API.

actions.name: run
actions.description: Run a DumplingAI capability or managed provider endpoint with JSON input.

type.description: The kind of catalog object to run.

id.description: The capability ID, such as search_news, or endpoint ID, such as firecrawl.scrape.

provider.description: An optional provider override supported by the selected capability.

input.description: The JSON input defined by the selected catalog item.

include_native.description: Whether to include the managed provider's native response payload.

inputSchema.description: A canonical DumplingAI unified execution request.

outputSchema.description: The JSON response returned by the DumplingAI API.

actions.name: search_catalog
actions.description: Search DumplingAI capabilities, providers, and managed provider endpoints.

limit.description: The maximum number of catalog matches to return.

type.description: The catalog object type to search or inspect.

inputSchema.description: A DumplingAI unified catalog search request.

outputSchema.description: The JSON response returned by the DumplingAI API.
